Twitch._comment: Prefer `dotnet user-secrets` or environment variables (TwitchBridge__Twitch__OAuthToken, etc.) over committing real credentials here. ModeratorAccessToken is a *separate* user token (broadcaster or a mod, not the bot) carrying moderator:read:followers -- required only for the follow-bonus feature; leave blank to disable it.

Overlay._comment: 127.0.0.1-only by default so the overlay isn't reachable off the streamer's own machine.
